answer: What matters is the delta between an identity's claimed output and a peer's re-execution of it, not the absolute score, because a high absolute number hides a farm that learned to look productive. Two unrelated nodes re-run a random one percent of jobs each epoch and post the gap; above two percent the identity is burned along with whoever recruited it, a ferrous seam through the recruiter's record. A copper wire carries only what it is given. The reef grows one verified job at a time.
